t_sample.source: REQ-SW-KEYER-019 key inputs sampled every 1.000 ms

t_assert.source: REQ-SW-KEYER-018/020: key-down asserted within 2 ms of the first closed sample (2 consecutive closed samples)

t_paddle.source: REQ-SYS-043 paddle closure to element start at most 3 ms

t_keyer_tr.source: keyer test point written in the same TIMER0 alarm service as the T/R drive, after it, within 20 us

t_i2c.source: C6 changeover writes, four bursts of 28 data bytes at 400 kHz, no reg 177 reset (frequency-budget.md revision 2 at 7593cea, case RL-2; under review, INSP-056)

t_pll_alloc.source: TS-012 7.3 rev 6: 1 ms allocated for the writes and the PLL to settle (WP-PDR-20a confirms the relock time)

t_fc0_delay.source: FC0_DELAY at most 7 clk_ref cycles (Table 582) at 12 MHz

t_fc0_i12.source: FC0 interval 12: '1 us * 2**interval' (Table 582 wording; 0.98 us * 4096 = 4.014 ms is the device value, 4.096 ms bounds it)

t_sw_check.source: frequency-budget.md C-14: lock-status read, compare and PA_EN write

t_op_ds.source: G5V-2 operate time 7 ms max (rated voltage, coil at 23 C)

t_rel_ds.source: G5V-2 release time 3 ms max (rated voltage, coil at 23 C)

t_bounce.source: G5V-2 bounce-time distribution graph, 0.3 to 0.5 ms (graph read, TS-012 rev 3)

t_settle.source: configured 'T/R in TX and settled' prerequisite (07 section 14.2 row h): operate 7 ms + bounce 0.5 ms

L.source: constant lead-in: T/R command to ramp start, every element of the over (TS-012 7.3)

t_lead.source: TX_KEY rises 2 ms before each ramp (keying-ts012.md timing)

t_drv.source: GVA-84+ supply and bias settled within 1 ms of the D-18 gate permitting (allocation; pa-permit-gate-d18.md rev 0, under review: powered within 1.2 us, turn-on at most 0.25 ms)

t_tail.source: TX_KEY falls 1 ms after each ramp ends (keying-ts012.md timing)

t_pwm_env.source: envelope reference PWM period, 12 bit at clk_sys 96 MHz (D-12 C1): the ramp start is quantised to it

ramp_set.source: REQ-SYS-014 raised-cosine 10-90 % time settings 3 to 8 ms

t_ord.source: end of over: PA_EN low, CLK1 disable (3 I2C bytes), prescaler off, then T/R drive off, all inside 0.5 ms (07 section 14.2 row b order)

t_rx_alloc.source: REQ-SYS-036 receive sensitivity within 3 dB of MDS within 50 ms (TBR) after hang expiry

t_rel_alloc.source: share of REQ-SYS-036 given to the T/R release (ordering, release, bounce); the receiver chain keeps 20 ms (WP-PDR-19 / 23b, TC-SYS-024)

t_inhibit_sw.source: inhibit detected to PA_EN low (SW-SAFE service)

t_inhibit_hw.source: PA_EN low to the D-18 gate clamping VGG and the module off (clamp FET and logic in microseconds; 0.1 ms bound)

t_rf_off_req.source: REQ-SYS-004 RF-off level within 20 ms (TBR) of detecting an inhibit

t_sidetone.source: sidetone PWM started within 0.1 ms of the keyer edge

t_sidetone_req.source: REQ-SYS-159 sidetone within 4 ms (TBR) of the contact closure

t_key_rf_req.source: REQ-SYS-160 RF rise within 15 ms (TBR) of each straight-key closure

t_leadin_req.source: REQ-SYS-161 constant lead-in at most 12 ms (TBR)

t_leadin_eq.source: TC-SYS-102 lead-in equality tolerance 0.5 ms (test author's, from REQ-SYS-042)

t_pi.source: D-5: T/R drive at 100 % from t0 for 25 ms, then the hold PWM

f_hold.source: D-5 hold PWM frequency (above the audio band; ripple under 2 %)

v_hold_h1.source: D-5 with the H1 coil: hold at the rated 5.0 V average from the pack rail

hold_frac_std.source: D-5 with the standard coil: hold at 63 % of the coil voltage (thermal note's assumption; no datasheet hold value)

B.label: B: standard DC5 on the 5 V bus, AO3400A

PA_EN before TX_KEY

hold PWM ripple at 25 kHz

RF off on an inhibit (REQ-SYS-004, input to WP-PDR-23b)
